decisions.content: Intel's 1 August 2024 release reports second-quarter GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $(0.38) and non-GAAP EPS of $0.02. It forecasts third-quarter 2024 revenue of $12.5-13.5B, GAAP EPS of $(0.24) and non-GAAP EPS of $(0.03).

decisions.content: CNBC reported on 1 August 2024 that Intel's adjusted EPS was 2 cents versus 10 cents expected and revenue was $12.83B versus $12.94B expected. It noted the GAAP net loss of $1.61B, or 38 cents per share, and said Intel guided the third quarter to an adjusted net loss of 3 cents per share on $12.5-13.5B revenue.

decisions.content: Broadcom announced a definitive agreement to acquire VMware for approximately $61B in cash and stock. The release also states that Broadcom would assume approximately $8B of VMware net debt, which is why the total transaction value is often quoted as about $69B.
decisions.title: Broadcom to Acquire VMware for Approximately $61 Billion in Cash and Stock

decisions.content: Reuters reported on 26 May 2022 that chipmaker Broadcom would buy VMware in a $61 billion deal, matching the cash-and-stock consideration in Broadcom's announcement. The report framed the transaction around the equity value and did not include the roughly $8 billion of VMware net debt that Broadcom said it would assume, the component that takes the total value to about $69 billion.
decisions.title: Chipmaker Broadcom to buy VMware in $61 bln deal

decisions.content: Computing reported on 27 May 2022 that Broadcom would acquire VMware in a $61 billion deal, again using the cash-and-stock figure from the announcement. The article described the agreement as a $61 billion acquisition and did not add the approximately $8 billion of net debt that Broadcom agreed to assume, so it did not produce the roughly $69 billion total that later coverage used.
decisions.title: Broadcom to acquire VMware in $61 billion deal

decisions.content: Reuters reported on 22 November 2023 that Broadcom closed its '$69 billion acquisition' of VMware after receiving China's regulatory approval. The headline uses the total value including assumed debt, not the $61B cash-and-stock consideration.
decisions.title: Broadcom closes $69 billion VMware deal after China approval

decisions.content: Computing reported on 23 November 2023 that Broadcom had completed its '$69bn acquisition' of VMware after China's approval. The article describes the deal as a $69 billion acquisition without separating the $61B consideration from the assumed debt.
decisions.title: Broadcom finally completes $69bn acquisition of VMware

decisions.content: Hystax's March 2026 explainer says the Broadcom acquisition of VMware was 'valued at approximately $69 billion'. It does not separate the cash-and-stock consideration from the debt that Broadcom assumed.
